title: Malaysian Inspired Beef Fajitas
description: Spicy beef fajitas with a malaysian twist, served with warm flour tortillas and a side of stir-fried tomatoes.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef seasoning and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the malaysian stir-fry sauce and stir to coat.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the juicy tomatoes and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the beef and vegetables onto the tortillas and topping with shredded cheese.
